prompt: Complete B2.6 Merge Recovery & Scope Split. Fix only the confirmed navigation, acceptance, Conversation terminal-response, and governance i18n blockers; add deterministic acceptance without real model credentials; create an exhaustive scope map; run merge gates; attach truthful evidence; do not commit or create a pull request.
allowed_actions: Edit Verrail navigation and acceptance tests to match the accepted seven-destination and Project-Target object-list contracts
Edit Conversation runtime terminal handling and focused tests
Add a test-only executable fixture used exclusively by the Verrail acceptance web server
Edit governance date-range i18n labels and representative tests
Create B2.6 scope, receipt, evidence, timeline, and advisory review records
Run focused tests, complete UI tests, acceptance, typecheck, repository tests, builds, UI gates, and diff checks
forbidden_actions: Add product features or change the accepted information architecture
Use real model credentials or paid model execution in acceptance
Expose a production environment switch for arbitrary Conversation runtime commands
Disable tests, weaken workspace access, or suppress failures
Discard existing work or rewrite unrelated inherited behavior
Commit, push, create a pull request, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record
expected_evidence: Seven-destination navigation unit result without unhandled errors
Project-Target-Work browser acceptance result at both desktop widths
Repository typecheck, tests, builds, UI gates, and diff integrity results
Advisory commit and pull-request readiness decision
stop_conditions: A fix requires changing the accepted product or navigation contract
Acceptance would require real model credentials or external model spend
A test-only runtime hook could be enabled in production
A remaining failure cannot be attributed to the current delta or reproduced against the base
Closure requires discarding or overwriting unrelated existing work
